entries.description: Post-launch hosted worker failure paths can expose raw provider stderr and worker stdout/stderr excerpts. classifyHostedExecutionError includes stderr verbatim in returned errors, and writeHostedWorkerOutputDebug stores raw stdout_excerpt/stderr_excerpt and parse errors in .aether/data/worker-debug artifacts. This conflicts with the provider/auth boundary docs requiring raw provider stdout/stderr, tokens, and auth output to stay out of summaries, generated context, and debug summaries.
entries.suggestion: Before release signoff, run all post-launch provider/API/auth failure text through a shared redaction/classification layer before errors, RawOutput summaries, and worker-debug excerpts are surfaced. Add fake-provider tests with sk-proj*/ghp_* output for stderr, stdout, parse-error debug artifacts, and worker result errors.

entries.description: The TS host legacy platform dispatcher still returns raw spawnWorker stdout/stderr. Availability checks swallow probe output, but direct TS-host worker dispatch results are not sanitized if this surface is used by wrappers or tests.
entries.suggestion: Either route provider/auth diagnostics exclusively through the Go AvailabilityStatus contract or apply the same redaction helper to TS spawnWorker results before any wrapper-visible output.

entries.description: Release and CI workflows use tag-pinned third-party actions such as actions/checkout@v4, setup-go@v5, setup-node@v4, and goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6. The release job has contents:write and npm publish credentials, so mutable action tags remain a supply-chain risk.
entries.suggestion: Pin privileged release workflow actions to immutable SHAs, especially in release.yml. Add a maintenance process for updating those SHAs.

entries.description: npm audit --package-lock-only --audit-level=low for .aether/ts-host currently reports 0 vulnerabilities across 88 total dependencies. .aether/ts also reports 0 vulnerabilities across 34 total dependencies.
entries.suggestion: Add the same npm audit gate for .aether/ts-host that already exists for .aether/ts so this stays enforced in CI/release.

entries.description: govulncheck is not installed in this environment, so a Go vulnerability database scan was not completed. go list -m all inventory succeeded, but no Go CVE claims are made from that inventory alone.
entries.suggestion: Install or vendor a govulncheck release gate and run it before tagging.

entries.description: Seal audit verified the earlier Phase 5 post-launch provider diagnostic redaction finding has remediation evidence: hosted worker RawOutput is sanitized before publication, failure stderr is sanitized before error formatting, worker-debug excerpts route through the sanitizer, and downstream build/continue/seal/TS summaries sanitize worker diagnostics.
entries.suggestion: Keep post-launch provider stderr/stdout redaction tests in pkg/codex/worker_test.go, pkg/codex/platform_dispatch_test.go, .aether/ts-host/test/go-bridge.test.ts, and .aether/ts-host/test/worker-dispatch.test.ts as release-blocking coverage.
